dtt.title: Data-to-text reporting
dtt.purpose: Express facts, relationships, and scope from structured input in report text.

skills.name: Contextualize a reversal with recent prior strength
skills.action: When a market move is framed as a reversal from a recently salient level or prior strength, use that comparison to contextualize the current move if the relevant historical comparison is available.

all_of: latest close is lower than the specified prior observed level
exclude_if: The comparison level is not identified or is not comparable.
A record-high claim lacks sufficient extended history.

preserve: The immediate comparison to prior strength gives the current decline context.
Keep a record-high characterization conditional on adequate longer-term history.

not_an_attempt: Reporting only the current session’s direction without a prior-level or prior-strength comparison.
Calling a level a record without adequate historical evidence.
required_elements: A current move described in relation to a prior level or prior strength.
Historical evidence sufficient to establish the comparison when used as fact.

all_of: latest close is lower than the specified prior observed level
exclude_if: The comparison level is not identified or is not comparable.
A record-high claim lacks sufficient extended history.

skills.name: Pair a salient percentage move with a level reference
skills.action: Anchor a salient index decline with its approximate percentage move and, where relevant, a nearby round-number level it had recently exceeded.

all_of: negative close-to-close percent return
exclude_if: The consecutive observations or comparable close basis are unavailable.

preserve: Keep the approximate percentage move distinct from the round-number level reference.
Use comparable observations for the return and verify the level against the relevant observation.

not_an_attempt: Giving only a direction or an unanchored qualitative description.
Treating a round-number reference as a percentage return.
required_elements: A stated percentage move for an index over a comparable interval.
A round-number level included as a separate reference when it is relevant to the description.

all_of: negative close-to-close percent return
exclude_if: The consecutive observations or comparable close basis are unavailable.

skills.name: Bound a reversal with an observed streak count
skills.action: When a decline interrupts a run of advances, describe it as the first decline in a bounded number of observed sessions, if consecutive comparable closes establish that count.

all_of: current close is lower than the previous available close
preceding observed closes form an uninterrupted upward run sufficient to establish the stated bounded span
exclude_if: Required observations are missing or not comparable.
The run count cannot be established from the available history.

preserve: Use the count to mark the current reversal against the immediately preceding sequence.
Count observed comparable closes; do not imply missing observations are present.

not_an_attempt: Saying only that an instrument continued higher or lower.
Stating a run count without enough consecutive observed closes to verify it.
required_elements: A current directional move.
A bounded count of consecutive comparable observations establishing that the move is the first in the stated span.

all_of: current close is lower than the previous available close
preceding observed closes form an uninterrupted upward run sufficient to establish the stated bounded span
exclude_if: Required observations are missing or not comparable.
The run count cannot be established from the available history.

skills.name: Quantify a maximum intraday decline against a clear basis
skills.action: Express an intraday loss relative to a stated comparison point when intraday data establishes the path and timing; do not infer a maximum loss from daily OHLC alone.

all_of: intraday decline measured against an identified comparison point
exclude_if: Intraday path or timing is unavailable.
The comparison point or percentage basis is unspecified.

preserve: The report emphasizes the maximum intraday extent rather than substituting a close-to-close figure.
State or establish the comparison basis before presenting the percentage as verified.

not_an_attempt: Reporting a close-to-close return as an intraday maximum decline.
Calling a daily low a timed intraday peak-to-trough move without the required path data.
required_elements: An intraday decline explicitly described relative to a comparison point.
Intraday prices and timing adequate to establish the claimed extent.

all_of: intraday decline measured against an identified comparison point
exclude_if: Intraday path or timing is unavailable.
The comparison point or percentage basis is unspecified.

skills.name: Organize supporting sector and catalyst context
skills.action: Support a broad market account with a selectively named set of sector or industry drivers and, when used, brief parenthetical event or company context; apply causal language only when that context is independently supplied.

exclude_if: No independent sector, company, or event context is available for the claims being made.

preserve: The report moves from the broad market decline to a selected set of named drivers.
Keep brief parenthetical context as supporting detail, not as proof of causation.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning sectors or companies without presenting them as supporting context for the broader move.
Asserting specific news or a causal mechanism based only on price observations.
required_elements: A broad move followed or supported by selected sector, industry, or company context.
Independent evidence for any asserted news catalyst or causal link.

exclude_if: No independent sector, company, or event context is available for the claims being made.

skills.name: Pair cross-market movement with causal investor framing
skills.action: Pair a cross-market move with an investor-behavior explanation when independently supplied evidence supports the proposed mechanism.

all_of: bond yield decreases over the latest comparable observation interval
equity index decreases over the same identified interval
exclude_if: The observations do not cover the same identified interval.
Causal evidence for the asserted investor behavior is unavailable.

preserve: Retain the explicit juxtaposition of yield and stock moves with the investor-behavior explanation.
Treat the mechanism as requiring evidence beyond simultaneous price changes.

not_an_attempt: Reporting market and yield moves together without an explanatory link.
Inferring safe-haven flows or investor motives from co-movement alone.
required_elements: A market move paired with an asserted investor-behavior mechanism.
Independent causal evidence for that mechanism.

all_of: bond yield decreases over the latest comparable observation interval
equity index decreases over the same identified interval
exclude_if: The observations do not cover the same identified interval.
Causal evidence for the asserted investor behavior is unavailable.

skills.name: Positive market lead with a selected benchmark streak
skills.action: Lead with the session’s broad market direction, then focus on a selected set of benchmark indices whose rebound ends a bounded recent losing streak. State the run as a count rather than enumerating every session.

all_of: For each selected index, a bounded run of consecutive observed close-to-close declines is followed by a latest close-to-close rise.
exclude_if: The observations do not provide enough consecutive, dated closes to establish the stated run.
A missing observation makes the claimed run length unestablished.

preserve: Lead with the market’s direction before supporting context.
Use a salient subset rather than exhaustively listing available instruments.
When reporting a counted streak, distinguish its counted run from a mere statement that prices continued in a direction.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning only that markets rose, with no bounded run or selected benchmark subset.
Saying an index 'continued higher' without specifying a counted streak.
required_elements: A lead indicating the session’s overall direction.
A selected subset of multiple same-type benchmark indices.
A counted losing run that the latest rise ends.

all_of: For each selected index, a bounded run of consecutive observed close-to-close declines is followed by a latest close-to-close rise.
exclude_if: The observations do not provide enough consecutive, dated closes to establish the stated run.
A missing observation makes the claimed run length unestablished.

skills.name: Causal catalyst with a specific news detail
skills.action: Connect the market move to a stated sector catalyst and, where external reporting supplies it, a specific company event. Use causal wording only when the causal link and news context are available.

all_of: A positive close-to-close move in the cited sector index, if the sector move itself is described.
exclude_if: External event or causal evidence is unavailable when asserting the catalyst or its effect.
The observations are not comparable across the selected interval.

preserve: Link a cited catalyst to the market move when the report explicitly makes that connection.
Treat company news and causal attribution as external context, not as facts established by market-price observations alone.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning a technology-sector move without attributing it as a catalyst.
Naming a company or analyst action without connecting it to the market move.
required_elements: A stated market move or sector bounce.
An explicitly linked catalyst or cause.
If a specific company event is included, external evidence for that event.

all_of: A positive close-to-close move in the cited sector index, if the sector move itself is described.
exclude_if: External event or causal evidence is unavailable when asserting the catalyst or its effect.
The observations are not comparable across the selected interval.

skills.name: Recent volatility as confidence context
skills.action: Place the latest market or volatility move against recent volatility context, and relate that context to investor confidence only when external evidence supports the sentiment claim.

all_of: Recent observed volatility-index closes establish the referenced episode; the latest close is lower than the previous available close if describing a latest-session easing.
exclude_if: The observed history is too short or has gaps that prevent establishing the referenced sequence.
Investor-sentiment effects are asserted without external evidence.

preserve: Use a recent volatility episode as context for the current market setting when the available history supports it.
Keep investor sentiment or confidence claims tied to external evidence rather than inferring them from prices alone.

not_an_attempt: Reporting a single volatility-index level without relating it to a recent episode.
Claiming an effect on investor confidence solely from a volatility-index reading.
required_elements: A contextual reference to recent volatility.
A connection between that context and the current stabilization or market setting.
External evidence if asserting investors’ confidence was tested.

all_of: Recent observed volatility-index closes establish the referenced episode; the latest close is lower than the previous available close if describing a latest-session easing.
exclude_if: The observed history is too short or has gaps that prevent establishing the referenced sequence.
Investor-sentiment effects are asserted without external evidence.

skills.name: Sector leaders contrasted with a laggard
skills.action: Organize a sector summary around selected leaders and a contrasting laggard, using comparable latest-interval returns to support both the positive and negative sides of the comparison.

all_of: The compared sector indices have comparable close-to-close returns over the same interval, with positive returns for the named leaders and lower performance for the contrasting sector.
exclude_if: The observations use different intervals or are not comparable.
The ranking is not established by the available comparable returns.

preserve: Select notable sector leaders rather than exhaustively enumerating every sector.
Contrast positive leaders with a sector that underperformed over the same comparable interval.
Use 'lagged' for underperformance without implying it was the worst performer unless the ranking establishes that.

not_an_attempt: Listing sector names without a relative-performance comparison.
Naming only positive sectors, with no contrasting laggard.
Calling sectors leaders or laggards without comparable observations for the same interval.
required_elements: Multiple same-type sector indices compared over a common interval.
A positive-performing subset identified as leaders.
A negatively performing or underperforming sector identified in contrast.

all_of: The compared sector indices have comparable close-to-close returns over the same interval, with positive returns for the named leaders and lower performance for the contrasting sector.
exclude_if: The observations use different intervals or are not comparable.
The ranking is not established by the available comparable returns.

skills.name: Lead with broad direction and quantified breadth
skills.action: Lead with a broad, salient market direction and, when the report chooses to quantify breadth, give the shared move threshold for the named comparison set. Treat claims of exhaustive breadth as requiring a defined comparison universe.

all_of: Each included equity index has a positive close-to-close percent return greater than the stated threshold.
exclude_if: The comparison set is undefined where the wording claims exhaustive breadth.
The latest observation is not a close or the comparison baseline is unavailable.

preserve: Use a concise broad direction before supporting detail.
When a threshold is stated, keep it tied to a clearly understood comparison set; do not infer an exhaustive universe from a limited table.

not_an_attempt: A list of individual instrument moves without a broad-direction lead.
A broad-direction lead with no shared threshold or other quantified breadth.
required_elements: A broad market-direction statement appears as the lead.
If a numerical threshold is used, it applies to the stated comparison set.

all_of: Each included equity index has a positive close-to-close percent return greater than the stated threshold.
exclude_if: The comparison set is undefined where the wording claims exhaustive breadth.
The latest observation is not a close or the comparison baseline is unavailable.

skills.name: Contextualize the session with calendar and recent-market framing
skills.action: When supplied context makes it relevant, place a session move against a nearby calendar milestone or a recent market episode; keep that framing distinct from claims about investors’ motives.

exclude_if: No independently supplied calendar, event, or longer-horizon context is available.

preserve: Use calendar or market-history framing when relevant context is supplied.
Do not treat contextual framing or an attributed investor motive as verified by price observations alone.

not_an_attempt: A session summary that contains no event, calendar, or longer-horizon context.
Presenting an unverified event or investor motive as if the price table establishes it.
required_elements: The report explicitly relates the current session to a broader calendar or market-history context.
Any causal or motive language is distinguishable from the contextual framing.

exclude_if: No independently supplied calendar, event, or longer-horizon context is available.

skills.name: Frame price action around a technical level
skills.action: When discussing a technical level, frame the session as interaction with that level and distinguish the intraday path from the ending position; use this framing only when both the level and relevant intraday evidence are supplied.

all_of: A technical reference level is independently supplied for the instrument and session.
exclude_if: Technical levels or intraday observations are absent.
Only daily OHLC data are available for a claim about the path or timing during the session.

preserve: Keep the technical reference explicit.
Describe intraday interaction and the ending position separately when the evidence supports both.
Do not derive a moving average or intraday path from daily OHLC alone.

not_an_attempt: A close-versus-close comparison without a technical reference level.
A statement that price merely rose or fell, without a technical-level relation.
A claim about intraday timing or path based only on daily closing values.
required_elements: A named technical level or indicator is used as the reference.
The wording relates price to that level during the session and/or at the end.
Intraday-path claims have independently available intraday evidence.

all_of: A technical reference level is independently supplied for the instrument and session.
exclude_if: Technical levels or intraday observations are absent.
Only daily OHLC data are available for a claim about the path or timing during the session.

skills.name: State relative outperformance within a comparable set
skills.action: When the report identifies an outperformer, compare percent returns over a common interval among comparable instruments, and state the comparison group or keep the ranking appropriately bounded.

all_of: The ranked instrument has the greatest percent return among the included comparable instruments over the same interval.
exclude_if: The instruments do not share a comparable return baseline and interval.
The comparison group is not identified or is broader than the available observations.

preserve: Use same-interval percent returns for relative performance, rather than comparing absolute index levels.
Bound the comparison to the instruments actually evaluated.

not_an_attempt: Calling an instrument an outperformer based only on its absolute index level.
Comparing returns across different intervals or incomparable units.
Mentioning an instrument’s positive move without a relative comparison.
required_elements: At least two comparable instruments are compared.
The comparison uses returns over the same interval and a common baseline.
The instrument identified as outperforming ranks ahead of the comparison group.

all_of: The ranked instrument has the greatest percent return among the included comparable instruments over the same interval.
exclude_if: The instruments do not share a comparable return baseline and interval.
The comparison group is not identified or is broader than the available observations.

skills.name: Attach supporting context to a performance explanation
skills.action: When adding a reason for relative performance, organize the cited supporting context after the performance statement; present a causal link only when independent causal evidence is supplied.

all_of: The cited market moves have the stated directions; a causal attribution additionally requires independent causal evidence.
exclude_if: Only coincident price movements are available for a causal explanation.
The included instruments do not have comparable latest close intervals.

preserve: Place supporting context after the performance claim when it is used.
Keep observed co-movement distinct from an asserted causal contribution.

not_an_attempt: A relative-performance statement with no supporting context.
Mentioning another instrument’s move without attributing or presenting it as an explanation.
Asserting that one move caused or helped another without the causal relation being independently supported.
required_elements: A performance statement is followed by supporting-context language.
If the report attributes the performance to that context, the causal relation is supported independently.

all_of: The cited market moves have the stated directions; a causal attribution additionally requires independent causal evidence.
exclude_if: Only coincident price movements are available for a causal explanation.
The included instruments do not have comparable latest close intervals.

skills.name: Contrast across market horizons
skills.action: When the report contrasts a session’s intraday direction with a different outcome over a longer market interval, state both horizons and make the contrast explicit; do not treat an intraday path as a close-to-close move.

all_of: The intraday direction is higher.
The longer-horizon direction is lower.
exclude_if: Intraday path or timing is unavailable.
The longer-horizon endpoints are not comparable or the index group is unclear.

preserve: The explicit contrast between the described intraday movement and the longer-period result.
Keep each direction attached to its stated horizon.

not_an_attempt: Reporting only the session close or its change from the previous close.
Mentioning movement without contrasting it with a distinct longer-horizon outcome.
required_elements: A direction or outcome tied to the session or intraday horizon.
A distinct longer-horizon outcome.
Wording that explicitly juxtaposes the two.

all_of: The intraday direction is higher.
The longer-horizon direction is lower.
exclude_if: Intraday path or timing is unavailable.
The longer-horizon endpoints are not comparable or the index group is unclear.

skills.name: Bounded streak reporting
skills.action: When explicitly reporting a bounded winning or losing streak, state the streak and its termination or continuation, using enough comparable history to establish the count; do not enumerate every observation unless the report does so.

all_of: The direction remains the same across each observation in the stated run.
The latest comparable observation ends that run.
exclude_if: History is too short to establish the stated run.
Missing observations or incomparable intervals break the claimed sequence.

preserve: The stated run count and its status as continued or snapped.
Do not infer a streak from a single direction statement.

not_an_attempt: Saying an instrument continued higher or lower without stating a bounded run count.
Reporting a single-period move without identifying a streak.
required_elements: An explicitly bounded count of consecutive outcomes.
A stated continuation or termination of that run.

all_of: The direction remains the same across each observation in the stated run.
The latest comparable observation ends that run.
exclude_if: History is too short to establish the stated run.
Missing observations or incomparable intervals break the claimed sequence.

skills.name: Forward calendar framing
skills.action: After describing a market outcome, use a near-future calendar or activity frame to situate what comes next, without turning that frame into an unsupported directional forecast.

exclude_if: No supplied calendar or event context supports the future-period description.

preserve: The bridge from the reported week to the near future.
Treat the activity description as contextual framing, not a price-direction forecast.

not_an_attempt: A directional prediction without a future-period context.
A calendar reference that is not used to frame the market narrative.
required_elements: A clearly future-oriented time frame.
Wording that uses that frame to contextualize the preceding market account.

exclude_if: No supplied calendar or event context supports the future-period description.

skills.name: Relative size and style performance
skills.action: Lead with a relative performance ranking when the report foregrounds a salient size or style segment against a broader comparison group; retain the actual comparison groups and interval rather than assuming a universal pairing.

all_of: The named comparison groups have comparable observations over the same interval.
The reported relative direction is established for those groups.
exclude_if: A named style or size group cannot be mapped to source instruments.
The comparison groups use different intervals or incomparable measures.

preserve: The relative, not merely absolute, nature of the claim.
Keep size and style descriptions tied to groups that are actually identifiable in the available source.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning one segment’s move without comparing it with another group.
Listing instruments without making a relative-performance claim.
required_elements: Two identifiable and comparable groups.
A stated relative-performance direction over a shared interval.

all_of: The named comparison groups have comparable observations over the same interval.
The reported relative direction is established for those groups.
exclude_if: A named style or size group cannot be mapped to source instruments.
The comparison groups use different intervals or incomparable measures.

skills.name: Grouped supporting context and attribution
skills.action: Organize supporting market context by placing similarly described sector moves together, then distinguish a broader index’s move and, when supplied, attach an explicitly sourced company or event explanation.

all_of: The paired sector instruments have the same reported direction over a comparable interval.
The broader index direction is stated separately; preserve whichever direction each instrument actually has.
exclude_if: Sector OHLC validity or interval comparability is insufficient for the claimed move.
External event or causal evidence is unavailable for an attribution.

preserve: The organization of sector performance as supporting context after the broad market account.
Keep company-news attribution distinct from table-verified index movement.
Retain the report’s actual dynamic direction mapping rather than hardcoding a sector sign.

not_an_attempt: A bare list of sector or company names with no supporting-context role.
Presenting a causal explanation as established when the required news or causal evidence is unavailable.
required_elements: A supporting-context clause after the main market account.
Related sector mentions grouped together or explicitly contrasted with a broader index.
Any causal explanation is supported by supplied event evidence.

all_of: The paired sector instruments have the same reported direction over a comparable interval.
The broader index direction is stated separately; preserve whichever direction each instrument actually has.
exclude_if: Sector OHLC validity or interval comparability is insufficient for the claimed move.
External event or causal evidence is unavailable for an attribution.

skills.name: Lead with a salient milestone and level anchor
skills.action: When a market report opens with a prominent index milestone, anchor it to a named session level; use a historical-record label only when the necessary longer-run comparison is available.

exclude_if: The claimed threshold is not supported by an observed level.
A historical-record claim lacks comparable extended history.

preserve: The report opens with the Dow milestone and its 30,000 level.
The level anchor is distinct from the historical-record and March-rally claims, which require additional context.

not_an_attempt: Mentioning an index without a level or milestone.
Calling a level an all-time record without the relevant historical comparison.
required_elements: Lead with a prominent index milestone.
Anchor the milestone to a stated level supported by the relevant observation.
For an all-time or first-time claim, have comparable extended history.

exclude_if: The claimed threshold is not supported by an observed level.
A historical-record claim lacks comparable extended history.

skills.name: Order a selected sector-performance ranking
skills.action: When presenting a ranked subset of sector performance, order the named sectors by comparable percentage returns over the same interval; describe the list as a subset if it does not include every sector.

all_of: Compare sector-index percentage returns from previous available closes to latest closes over a common interval; rank by return rather than by index level.
exclude_if: The compared observations do not share a comparable interval or baseline.
Close observations needed to calculate the returns are unavailable.

preserve: The report identifies Energy as the leading sector and follows it with named sector comparisons.
The observed ranking choice remains distinct from whether the supplied values support the stated ordering.

not_an_attempt: Naming several sectors without presenting an order or ranking.
Ordering sectors by index levels rather than comparable returns.
required_elements: Compare sector-index percentage returns over a common interval and baseline.
Present the stated sectors in the corresponding rank order, or explicitly identify the list as a selected subset.

all_of: Compare sector-index percentage returns from previous available closes to latest closes over a common interval; rank by return rather than by index level.
exclude_if: The compared observations do not share a comparable interval or baseline.
Close observations needed to calculate the returns are unavailable.

skills.name: Frame a rotation with an opposed-return comparison
skills.action: When framing a market rotation, pair the thematic interpretation with an explicit contrast between instruments moving in opposite directions over a stated common interval; use the comparison only when both the interval data and any invoked event context are available.

all_of: The compared instruments have opposed percentage-return directions over the same stated interval.
exclude_if: The instruments lack comparable price observations at both interval endpoints.
The return directions are not opposed.
The interval or required event context is unavailable.

preserve: The report names a value/reopen and reflation rotation before supplying an opposed-direction comparison.
The comparison is framed over a bounded period tied to event context and an endpoint, rather than as a latest-session-only move.
The named instruments and quoted returns are not verified by the supplied table.

not_an_attempt: Offering a thematic rotation label without a directional comparison.
Mentioning multiple instruments whose reported moves are not opposed.
Treating an event reference as verified market data.
required_elements: State a market-rotation or similar thematic frame.
Compare at least two same-type instruments over the same interval.
Show opposed return directions and connect the contrast to the frame.
Have the relevant price history and any invoked external event context available.

all_of: The compared instruments have opposed percentage-return directions over the same stated interval.
exclude_if: The instruments lack comparable price observations at both interval endpoints.
The return directions are not opposed.
The interval or required event context is unavailable.

skills.name: Compact numeric anchors for named leaders
skills.action: When suitable, identify selected sector or industry groups as leaders by attaching signed numeric move figures to their names in a compact list. Use this only when the figures' unit, baseline, and comparison interval are established and comparable; do not imply that a sector-index series directly verifies a distinct industry group such as banks.

all_of: positive absolute change over a stated, comparable interval
exclude_if: The move's unit or comparison interval is unspecified.
A named group has no comparable source series; do not substitute a broader sector index without justification.

preserve: A concise list connects named leaders with signed numeric figures.
The report uses the leader framing without explicitly claiming a complete ranking.

not_an_attempt: A list of group names without numeric move anchors.
A list of numeric levels that are not presented as moves.
An ordering or ranking claim unsupported by the wording or comparable data.
required_elements: Selected sector or industry groups are identified as leaders or standout movers.
Signed numeric figures are attached to the group names as move anchors.
The relevant move unit and comparison interval are known before treating the figures as verified changes.

all_of: positive absolute change over a stated, comparable interval
exclude_if: The move's unit or comparison interval is unspecified.
A named group has no comparable source series; do not substitute a broader sector index without justification.

skills.name: Dated prior-close comparison with historical framing
skills.action: When contextualizing an index level against a dated prior close, state the comparison directly; characterize that prior close as a record only when longer-term history establishes it.

all_of: The latest observed level is above the specified prior observed close.
exclude_if: The prior close cannot be identified or compared on a consistent basis
A record designation is used without sufficient extended price history

preserve: The direct comparison to a dated prior close
Record framing only when independently established by longer history

not_an_attempt: Mentioning that an index rose without comparing its level with an identifiable earlier close
Calling a prior close a record based only on a short sample
required_elements: Compare the latest observed level with an identifiable prior close
If calling the prior close a record, have sufficient extended history to establish that status

all_of: The latest observed level is above the specified prior observed close.
exclude_if: The prior close cannot be identified or compared on a consistent basis
A record designation is used without sufficient extended price history

skills.name: Counted close streak and reversal
skills.action: Describe a counted losing streak as a bounded sequence of consecutive observed close-to-close declines, and say it was snapped when a subsequent observed close reverses the direction.

all_of: Four consecutive observed close-to-close changes are negative.
The subsequent observed close-to-close change is positive.
exclude_if: Required consecutive observed closes are unavailable
Observation gaps prevent establishing the consecutive sequence

preserve: The bounded count of losing sessions
The subsequent close reversal that makes “snaps” apt

not_an_attempt: Saying an index continued higher without enumerating or otherwise establishing a counted streak
Calling a decline a snapped losing streak without the required consecutive declines and a subsequent reversal
Counting across missing or nonconsecutive observations as if the closes were consecutive
required_elements: Four consecutive observed close-to-close declines for the stated four-day streak
A subsequent observed close higher than the preceding close to establish that the streak snapped

all_of: Four consecutive observed close-to-close changes are negative.
The subsequent observed close-to-close change is positive.
exclude_if: Required consecutive observed closes are unavailable
Observation gaps prevent establishing the consecutive sequence

skills.name: Lead with selected benchmark developments
skills.action: Open with a small set of salient benchmark-index developments, then move to narrower technology and company-level context when the report does so; this is an ordering choice, not a requirement to cover every index.
preserve: The report begins with three major index developments before turning to technology and company context.
The opening selects salient events rather than enumerating all available instruments.

not_an_attempt: Listing instruments in a different order without foregrounding selected benchmark developments.
Treating the opening as a requirement to report every available index.
required_elements: The opening foregrounds a selected set of benchmark-index developments.
The report then shifts to narrower market or instrument context.

skills.name: Frame an intraday high followed by a fade
skills.action: When an intraday retreat is salient, describe a session high followed by fading only when the report explicitly frames that movement; distinguish the session high from the later close and do not imply an independently verified intraday path from OHLC alone.

all_of: The selected-session high is above the selected-session close.
exclude_if: Intraday path or timing is asserted without intraday prices and times.

preserve: The report explicitly uses the intraday-high-to-fade framing.
Keep intraday highs distinct from closes; the table supports the high and lower close but not the path between them.

not_an_attempt: Reporting only that the close was below the high without describing a retreat.
Calling a quoted level a close or a record high without that evidence.
required_elements: The wording identifies an intraday or session high.
The wording describes a subsequent fade or retreat from that high.

all_of: The selected-session high is above the selected-session close.
exclude_if: Intraday path or timing is asserted without intraday prices and times.

skills.name: Contrast a near-threshold level with a historical milestone
skills.action: Juxtapose a current near-threshold level with a prior-session milestone when both are stated; identify whether the threshold comparison is based on an intraday high or another observed field, and require history to substantiate a record claim.

all_of: A specified current-session observed level is below the stated threshold.
exclude_if: The stated threshold comparison field is unavailable.
A historical record is asserted without sufficient extended history.

preserve: The sentence contrasts the current Nasdaq threshold shortfall with a record-close milestone from the prior day.
Keep the current-session threshold claim separate from the historical record claim.

not_an_attempt: Reporting only that an instrument is below a threshold.
Calling a prior observation a record without historical evidence.
required_elements: A current observed level is framed as falling short of a threshold.
A distinct prior-session milestone is juxtaposed with it.

all_of: A specified current-session observed level is below the stated threshold.
exclude_if: The stated threshold comparison field is unavailable.
A historical record is asserted without sufficient extended history.

skills.name: Report a bounded counted direction run

all_of: The selected standout instrument or instruments have positive percentage returns greater than the stated threshold versus the previous available close.
exclude_if: Instrument identity is ambiguous among multiple series.
The compared observations do not share a comparable close and return basis.
Any compared instrument lacks two comparable closes.

preserve: Use a standout subset to give movement emphasis when the source supports it.
Keep percentage-return reporting distinct from absolute changes and level-only reporting.
Name the relevant series when multiple instruments could fit a broad label.

not_an_attempt: Listing instruments without emphasizing a salient subset.
Reporting point changes or levels instead of percentage returns.
Treating an ambiguous instrument label as a verified specific index.
required_elements: Select one or more standout instruments from a comparable group.
State a percentage move or threshold for that subset.
Identify the instruments clearly enough to distinguish them from similar series.

all_of: The selected standout instrument or instruments have positive percentage returns greater than the stated threshold versus the previous available close.
exclude_if: Instrument identity is ambiguous among multiple series.
The compared observations do not share a comparable close and return basis.
Any compared instrument lacks two comparable closes.

skills.name: Sector breadth with a concise winners-and-laggards contrast
skills.action: Summarize sector breadth with a count when the sector universe is available, then compactly identify declining sectors; use named advancing groups as supporting detail when evidenced.

all_of: Within the identified sector universe, at least one instrument has a positive close-to-close direction and at least one has a negative close-to-close direction.
exclude_if: The relevant sector universe or its denominator is not identifiable.
Any instrument included in the breadth count lacks two comparable closes.

preserve: When a comparable sector universe is supplied, organize the summary around breadth and its exceptions.
Use a short parenthetical or equivalent compact form for declining groups when suitable.
Name advancing groups only when the source supports their direction; do not infer constituent or industry performance from a sector index alone.

not_an_attempt: Naming sector winners and losers without a breadth count.
Giving a breadth count without identifying the direction of the exceptions.
Listing sectors without organizing them as breadth plus directional contrast.
required_elements: A count or proportion of advancing sectors within an identifiable sector universe.
Identification of the declining sector subset when there is one.
Optional supporting names of advancing sectors, only when evidenced.

all_of: Within the identified sector universe, at least one instrument has a positive close-to-close direction and at least one has a negative close-to-close direction.
exclude_if: The relevant sector universe or its denominator is not identifiable.
Any instrument included in the breadth count lacks two comparable closes.

skills.name: Attributed historical or intraday context
skills.action: Add a brief, attributed historical or intraday statistic as supporting context after the main market summary when the underlying source, historical observations, and intraday evidence are available.

exclude_if: The attributed source or relevant historical period is unavailable.
Only daily closes or OHLC without the required intraday timing evidence are supplied.

preserve: Use this as supporting context after the main market summary when suitable.
Retain attribution for externally sourced comparisons.
Require relevant history and intraday evidence for a bounded historical count; do not infer an intraday path from daily OHLC alone.

not_an_attempt: An unattributed historical statistic.
A table-derived close-to-close observation described as an intraday path.
A general comment about the day without a historical comparison or supporting statistic.
required_elements: Attribute the statistic to its source.
State a historical comparison or bounded count.
Use the history and intraday observations needed to verify the stated comparison.

exclude_if: The attributed source or relevant historical period is unavailable.
Only daily closes or OHLC without the required intraday timing evidence are supplied.

skills.name: Quantify selected equity-index rebounds from intraday lows
skills.action: When intraday path data are available, describe a rebound from a session low using approximate or thresholded point amounts for selected equity indexes; keep the stated instruments and moves together in a compact comparison. Do not infer the direction or sequence of movement from daily OHLC ranges alone.

all_of: A positive intraday move from the session low to a later observed level is established by path or timing data.
exclude_if: Intraday sequence is unavailable and only high and low are supplied.
The instrument identity or point-unit comparability is unresolved.

preserve: The report anchors the described intraday moves with point amounts, including thresholded and approximate amounts.
It groups three selected equity indexes in one concise comparison rather than enumerating every index.
Treat ‘off its lows’ as a path claim: use it only when intraday timing or path evidence establishes the rebound.

not_an_attempt: Reporting close-to-close changes or percent returns
Calling a daily high-low range a rebound without evidence that the high followed the low
Requiring a comprehensive list of indexes or pairing with other asset classes
required_elements: Describe an upward move from an observed session low toward a later intraday level
Anchor the move with a point amount or threshold
Attribute the move to the named instrument

all_of: A positive intraday move from the session low to a later observed level is established by path or timing data.
exclude_if: Intraday sequence is unavailable and only high and low are supplied.
The instrument identity or point-unit comparability is unresolved.

skills.name: Frame a session decline as returning an index to negative territory for the week
skills.action: When the latest close falls below the prior close and moves an index from above to below its observed week-start close, a headline may connect the session decline to that return-to-negative weekly status. Use the weekly framing only when those close comparisons are available; the arithmetic supports the status, not a causal mechanism.

all_of: The latest close is below the prior observed close.
The latest close is below the observed week-start close, while the prior close is above that same week-start close.
exclude_if: The week-start or prior close is unavailable.
The observations are not comparable closes for the same instrument.
The index remains on the same side of its week-start close.

preserve: The compact headline links a latest-session move with a short-horizon weekly status.
The phrase “back into” conveys a crossing from the positive side of the weekly reference to the negative side.
Treat the causal wording as rhetoric, not as a mechanism established by close data alone.

not_an_attempt: Reporting only that markets fell in the latest session without framing the move against a weekly baseline.
Describing a weekly loss without indicating that the latest session move took the index back below the baseline.
required_elements: State or imply a latest-session decline.
Frame the latest move against a week-start close, with the prior close above and the latest close below that reference.

all_of: The latest close is below the prior observed close.
The latest close is below the observed week-start close, while the prior close is above that same week-start close.
exclude_if: The week-start or prior close is unavailable.
The observations are not comparable closes for the same instrument.
The index remains on the same side of its week-start close.

skills.name: Anchor volatility framing in session range
skills.action: When the report opens by characterizing a volatile session, use the observed high–low range to anchor that framing; treat claims that such ranges are becoming typical as historical claims, not as established by one session.

exclude_if: High or low is missing or invalid.

preserve: The report leads with an emphatic characterization of the session as wild.
It connects that framing to a high–low swing, then extends the characterization to a claimed pattern.

not_an_attempt: Calling a session volatile without relating the description to observed intraday prices.
Treating a single session's range as proof that the same range is now typical.
required_elements: A volatility characterization tied to an observed high–low range.
Any claim that the range is typical is presented as a separate historical assertion.

exclude_if: High or low is missing or invalid.
The description claims a historical norm without adequate comparable history.

skills.name: Qualify a claimed trend break
skills.action: When describing a possible break in a recent trend, qualify the outlook with an explicit time-limiting phrase rather than presenting the break as settled.

skills.name: Contrast selected winners and laggards
skills.action: Organize a market recap by contrasting a selected group of winners with a selected group of laggards, and use wording that distinguishes observed direction from an asserted explanation such as profit-taking.

exclude_if: A compared instrument lacks a previous available close.

not_an_attempt: A list of movers with no contrast between positive and negative directions.
Attributing a move to profit-taking or another cause without separately treating that attribution as an explanation.
required_elements: A selected group characterized as outperforming or rising.
A contrasting selected group characterized as declining or underperforming.
Where a cause is stated, distinguish it from the observed price direction.

all_of: At least one instrument has a positive latest-close change and at least one has a negative latest-close change, measured against each instrument's previous available close.
exclude_if: A compared instrument lacks a previous available close.
Instrument units or quote bases do not permit a meaningful comparison of the stated direction.
A causal explanation is asserted without causal evidence.
