skills.name: Make a definition fragment an explicit continuation
skills.action: Turn a definition’s subjectless follow-up fragment into an explicit continuation, using a connective and a verb that refer back to the defined term.

all_of: A subjectless noun-phrase fragment follows a sentence or fragment defining a term.
The fragment can be read as adding another defining characteristic of that same term.
exclude_if: The fragment has an independent subject or introduces a separate topic.

preserve: That the added characteristic refers to the term being defined.
The meaning of the characteristic as a medium of payment or exchange.

records.abstract_quote: Dinero: Cualquier cosa de aceptación general que se utiliza en el intercambio de bienes y servicios o en cualquier transacción financiera. Medio de pago o de cambio.
records.adaptation_quote: El dinero es cualquier cosa de aceptación general utilizado en el intercambio de bienes y servicios o en cualquier transacción financiera. También es el medio de pago o de cambio.

skills.name: Separate a consequent with a sentence boundary
skills.action: Place a full stop before a sentence-initial “por consiguiente” when separating it from the preceding statement.

all_of: The source has “por consiguiente” between two clauses, preceded by a comma.
exclude_if: The connector is syntactically embedded in a clause rather than beginning a separate sentence.

preserve: The consequential relationship signaled by “por consiguiente.”

records.abstract_quote: en nombre de nuestra Institución, por consiguiente, para verificar
records.adaptation_quote: en nombre de nuestra Institución. Por consiguiente, para verificar

skills.name: Turn function nouns into coordinated verbs
skills.action: Replace a construction of “cumplir funciones de” plus action nouns with coordinated verbs that express those actions directly.

all_of: The source uses “cumplir funciones de” followed by one or more action nouns.
exclude_if: The source distinguishes the function from carrying out the action itself.

preserve: Both actions expressed in the source.
The dispositions as the object of those actions.

records.abstract_quote: cumplen funciones de ejecución y control de disposiciones
records.adaptation_quote: ejecutan y controlan disposiciones

skills.name: Everyday wording for a close relationship
skills.action: Replace an elevated expression for a close relationship with an ordinary intensifier and relation adjective, as in changing “íntimamente vinculados” to “muy relacionados.”

all_of: The source describes entities as closely related using an intensifying adverb and a participial or adjectival expression.
exclude_if: The source specifies a technical type or degree of relationship that the replacement would not preserve.

preserve: Keep the same entities and their general relationship.

records.abstract_quote: El Estado de Resultados y el Estado de Situación Financiera se encuentran íntimamente vinculados.
records.adaptation_quote: El estado de resultados y el estado de situación financiera están muy relacionados.

skills.name: Lowercase generic financial statement names
skills.action: Use lowercase for generic names of financial statements in running Spanish prose where the source capitalizes their component words.

all_of: A financial statement name is used generically within a sentence.
exclude_if: Capitalization is part of an official title, heading, or proper name.

preserve: Keep the same financial statement names.

records.abstract_quote: El Estado de Resultados y el Estado de Situación Financiera se encuentran íntimamente vinculados.
records.adaptation_quote: El estado de resultados y el estado de situación financiera están muy relacionados.

skills.name: Preverbal subject in a subordinate clause
skills.action: Move an overt subject in a Spanish subordinate clause from after its verb to before the verb; in this example, “desear” is also replaced by “querer.”

all_of: A Spanish subordinate clause has an overt subject placed after its verb.
exclude_if: Moving the subject would make its reference ambiguous or materially change the clause’s focus.

preserve: Keep the same subject and the same thing they wish to consume.
Keep the subordinate clause subjunctive and preserve the question.

records.abstract_quote: ¿Qué tenemos en abundancia que deseen consumir ellos?
records.adaptation_quote: ¿Qué tenemos en abundancia que ellos quieran consumir?

skills.name: Directly locate results in a table
skills.action: Replace an impersonal or passive-style statement that results are presented in a table with a direct statement that they are in the table, attaching the case-setting phrase to “los resultados.”

all_of: The source says that results are presented or shown in a table.
A phrase identifies the case to which those results belong.
exclude_if: The source specifically emphasizes the act of presenting rather than the results’ location.

preserve: Keep the results associated with the same case.
Keep the reference to the following table.

records.abstract_quote: Para este caso, los resultados se presentan en la siguiente tabla.
records.adaptation_quote: Los resultados de este caso están en la siguiente tabla.

skills.name: Adverbial frequency wording
skills.action: Replace a frequency phrase formed with “de forma” and an adjective with the corresponding frequency adverb when available.

all_of: The source uses a “de forma” phrase to express the frequency or regularity of an action.
exclude_if: The corresponding adverb would change the meaning or sound unnatural in context.

preserve: Preserve the frequency or regularity expressed in the source.

records.abstract_quote: Una forma de aprovechar al máximo las inversiones en el transcurso del tiempo es comprometerse a invertir un determinado monto en dólares de forma periódica.
records.adaptation_quote: El compromiso de invertir un monto en dólares periódicamente es una forma de aprovechar las inversiones en el transcurso del tiempo.

skills.name: Wording for illustrative lists
skills.action: Shorten “tales como” to “como” when introducing examples, and replace “etc.” with “entre otros” for a non-exhaustive list.

all_of: The source introduces examples with “tales como” or ends an illustrative list with “etc.”.
exclude_if: The list is exhaustive, or replacing its ending would change its scope.

preserve: Keep the listed examples and preserve that the list is non-exhaustive.

records.abstract_quote: Posibilidad de obtener mayores rendimientos versus los instrumentos de inversión tradicionales tales como cuentas de ahorro, certificados de inversión, etc.
records.adaptation_quote: Posibilidad de obtener mayores rendimientos versus los instrumentos de inversión tradicionales como cuentas de ahorro, certificados de inversión, entre otros.

skills.name: Spell out monetary amounts and percentages
skills.action: Render numeric monetary amounts and percentages in Spanish words, spelling out the currency where the source uses a currency symbol.

all_of: The source contains a monetary amount or percentage written with digits.
A currency symbol or percentage sign identifies the unit.
exclude_if: The source's numeric notation is part of a formula, code, or other format where spelling it out would alter its function.

preserve: The amount, currency, and percentage value.
The relationship of the one percent to all fund assets.

records.abstract_quote: Si el inversionista invirtió, por ejemplo, $10,000 y en ese momento el fondo tenía un valor de $1 millón, ese inversionista dejó de ser dueño de $10,000 y pasó a ser propietario del 1% de todos los activos del fondo
records.adaptation_quote: Si el inversionista invirtió diez mil dólares y en ese momento el fondo tenía un valor de un millón de dólares, ese inversionista dejó de ser dueño de diez mil dólares y pasó a ser propietario del uno por ciento de todos los activos del fondo

skills.name: Reorder and streamline a definition
skills.action: In a definition, move an interpretive or qualifying phrase before the defined term and replace a discourse lead-in such as «digamos sencillamente que» with a direct «X es Y» construction.

all_of: The source defines a term using a lead-in such as «digamos … que es».
A qualifying phrase specifying the sense or approach appears within or after that lead-in.
exclude_if: Moving the qualifier would make it unclear which definition or term it applies to.

preserve: The defined term and its definition.
The qualification about the meaning of the concept and the economic approach.

records.abstract_quote: La producción, digamos sencillamente que es, entre las diferentes acepciones del concepto y según el enfoque económico, crear cosas o servicios con valor económico.
records.adaptation_quote: Entre los diferentes significados del concepto y según el enfoque económico, la producción es crear productos o servicios con un valor económico.

skills.name: Nominalize an evaluated influence clause
skills.action: Recast an evaluative clause of the form «resalta el hecho de que X influye en Y» as an impersonal evaluative statement with a nominalized relation, such as «es destacable la influencia de X en Y».

all_of: The source uses an evaluative expression followed by «el hecho de que» and an active clause with «influir en».
exclude_if: The rewrite would obscure which entity influences which entity.

preserve: That financial education is the influencer.
That the behavior of consumers and investors is what is influenced.

records.abstract_quote: resalta el hecho de que la educación financiera influye en el comportamiento de las personas consumidoras e inversionistas
records.adaptation_quote: es destacable la influencia de la educación financiera en el comportamiento de las personas consumidoras e inversionistas

skills.name: Shorten a topic-framing transition
skills.action: Replace the multiword topic transition «En cuanto a» with a concise equivalent such as «Respecto a».

all_of: The source uses «En cuanto a» to introduce the topic being discussed.
exclude_if: The phrase expresses a different relation than topic framing in its context.

preserve: The topic introduced by the transition.

records.abstract_quote: En cuanto a los resultados concretos, resalta el hecho de que
records.adaptation_quote: Respecto a los resultados concretos, es destacable la influencia de

skills.name: Condense a general-frequency expression
skills.action: Replace the multiword frequency expression «Por lo general» with «Generalmente» or an equivalent Spanish adverb.

all_of: The source uses «Por lo general» to state that something is generally true or usual.
exclude_if: The expression refers to a specific period or frequency rather than a general tendency.

preserve: The general, non-absolute frequency qualification.

records.abstract_quote: Por lo general son gratis o conllevan a un cargo mínimo.
records.adaptation_quote: Generalmente, son gratis o tienen un costo mínimo.

skills.name: Use a direct cost construction
skills.action: Replace «conllevar a un cargo» with a direct possession or cost construction such as «tener un costo».

all_of: The source uses «conllevar a un cargo» to state that an item incurs a charge.
exclude_if: The charge is only a possible consequence and not a cost the item has or incurs.

preserve: The alternative between being free and having a minimal charge.
The minimal amount of the charge.

records.abstract_quote: son gratis o conllevan a un cargo mínimo
records.adaptation_quote: son gratis o tienen un costo mínimo

skills.name: Postverbal partitive in a se-passive clause
skills.action: Move a partitive noun phrase from before a Spanish se-passive verb to immediately after the verb, as in recasting “una parte” as postverbal “parte.”

all_of: The source has a se-passive clause with a partitive noun phrase before the verb.
The partitive phrase is the thing being reserved or acted upon in that clause.
exclude_if: Moving the phrase would make its role or scope ambiguous.

preserve: The same portion of resources is reserved.
The resources' connection to the distribution phase and the purpose of restarting the economic process remain unchanged.

records.abstract_quote: una parte de los recursos percibidos en la fase de distribución se reserva
records.adaptation_quote: se reserva parte de los recursos recibidos en la fase de distribución

skills.name: Spell out percentage figures
skills.action: Render percentage numerals as Spanish words instead of digits and the percent sign.

all_of: The source presents a percentage using digits and a percent sign.
exclude_if: The surrounding context requires a fixed numeric format, such as a table or formula.

preserve: The percentage value and its denominator or population remain the same.

records.abstract_quote: el 71% de los adultos no tienen conocimiento sobre acciones y bonos
records.adaptation_quote: el setenta y un porciento de los adultos no sabe sobre acciones y bonos

skills.name: Shorten repeated knowledge claims
skills.action: Replace a repeated “no tener conocimiento sobre/de [subject]” construction with “no saber sobre [subject]” in parallel knowledge claims.

all_of: The source has coordinated or parallel claims using “no tener conocimiento sobre/de” the subjects being listed.
exclude_if: The source distinguishes lack of knowledge from another state, such as lack of access or awareness.

preserve: The negative knowledge claim and each subject it applies to.
The scope of the claim across the listed groups or percentages.

records.abstract_quote: no tienen conocimiento sobre acciones y bonos
records.adaptation_quote: no sabe sobre acciones y bonos

skills.name: Recast a parenthetical survey date
skills.action: Reorder a survey-led clause so the survey is introduced first, and recast a parenthetical year after a place as a temporal phrase.

all_of: The source begins with a place followed by a parenthetical year before introducing the survey or study.
exclude_if: The parenthetical year identifies a different event or modifies something other than the survey or study.

preserve: The survey is associated with the same place and year.
The date remains a temporal detail of the survey.

records.abstract_quote: En Japón (2000) una encuesta revela
records.adaptation_quote: Una encuesta realizada en Japón, durante el año dos mil, revela

skills.name: Compress the “Y aquí es donde” frame
skills.action: Remove the discourse-initial “Y” and the framing phrase “es donde” from “Y aquí es donde [event occurs],” stating the event directly with “Aquí.”

all_of: The source begins the clause with the Spanish frame “Y aquí es donde” before the event.
exclude_if: The initial conjunction or framing phrase carries a contrast or other discourse relation that needs to be explicit.

preserve: The here-based locative reference and the event being described.

records.abstract_quote: Y aquí es donde surge la necesidad
records.adaptation_quote: Aquí surge la necesidad

skills.name: Replace an elliptical possessive with a matching adjective
skills.action: Replace an elliptical possessive phrase of the form “y la de [family/person]” with a coordinated adjective describing the second category.

all_of: The source coordinates a first adjective or category with “la de [person or group]” to identify a second related category.
exclude_if: The possessive phrase refers to a distinct item rather than a second category of the same thing.

preserve: Both the personal and family-related categories of protection.

records.abstract_quote: protección personal y la de la familia
records.adaptation_quote: protección personal y familiar

skills.name: Spell out financial quantities
skills.action: In Spanish financial prose, render digit-written quantities as Spanish number words and expand a currency symbol into its currency name.

all_of: The source contains digit-written amounts, durations, rates, or other quantities in running prose.
A currency symbol is used for an amount if the currency name is to be expanded.
exclude_if: The numeric form is required by a table, formula, citation, or other fixed-format presentation.

preserve: The amount, currency, duration, rate, and compounding frequency.

records.abstract_quote: préstamo de $1,000 a 5 años plazo al 12% capitalizable mensualmente
records.adaptation_quote: préstamo de mil dólares a cinco años al doce por ciento capitalizable mensualmente

skills.name: Inline and reorder schedule details
skills.action: Turn a parenthetical schedule detail into comma-separated inline details, placing the daily hours before the weekday distribution.

all_of: A Spanish sentence gives a weekly work-hour total and a parenthetical specifies its daily hours and weekday distribution.
exclude_if: The parenthetical contains a qualification that would be obscured or detached by making it an inline list.

preserve: The weekly total, daily hours, and Monday-to-Friday distribution, including their relationship to one another.

records.abstract_quote: Jornada de trabajo son 45 horas semanales distribuidas de lunes a viernes (nueve horas por día).
records.adaptation_quote: La jornada de trabajo son cuarenta y cinco horas semanales, nueve horas por día, de lunes a viernes.

skills.name: Split a proposition from its follow-up comment
skills.action: Split a coordinated clause that gives a statement and then comments on it into two sentences, beginning the second sentence with the source’s referring expression.

all_of: A Spanish sentence coordinates a proposition with a following clause that refers back to that proposition using a demonstrative such as “estos”.
exclude_if: The coordination expresses a dependency or condition that would be lost by ending the sentence.

preserve: The reference of the second sentence’s demonstrative to the indicators introduced in the first.

records.abstract_quote: el funcionamiento de la economía y estos son útiles
records.adaptation_quote: el funcionamiento de la economía. Estos son útiles

skills.name: Simplify a paired-beneficiary construction
skills.action: Replace the paired Spanish construction “tanto para X como para Y” with “para X y Y” when it expresses the same two beneficiaries.

all_of: The source uses “tanto … como” to coordinate two parallel beneficiaries of the same statement.
exclude_if: The paired construction marks a contrast, emphasis, or other distinction beyond listing both beneficiaries.

preserve: Both beneficiary groups and their shared relation to the indicators’ usefulness.

records.abstract_quote: útiles tanto para las empresas como para las personas
records.adaptation_quote: útiles para las empresas y las personas

skills.name: Shorten the continuation-of-analysis phrase
skills.action: Replace “seguir haciendo el análisis” with the shorter continuation “seguir con el análisis.”

all_of: The source uses “seguir haciendo” followed by a noun phrase naming an analysis or comparable ongoing activity.
exclude_if: The source distinguishes continuing the act of carrying out the activity from continuing or resuming the activity itself.

preserve: The possibility, expressed by “podríamos,” of continuing the analysis and its subject matter.

records.abstract_quote: podríamos seguir haciendo el análisis sobre otros impuestos
records.adaptation_quote: podríamos seguir con el análisis sobre otros impuestos

skills.name: Parallel clauses compressed into participial phrases
skills.action: Replace parallel finite clauses of the form “lo que” + verb with matching past-participle phrases, as in “lo ganado” and “lo gastado.”

all_of: The source uses parallel “lo que” clauses to name two corresponding activities or outcomes.
exclude_if: The clauses express different actors or relationships that would be obscured by participial phrases.

preserve: The parallel contrast between earnings and spending.

records.abstract_quote: lo que ganas y lo que gastas
records.adaptation_quote: lo ganado y lo gastado

skills.name: Prefatory framing and emphasis omitted
skills.action: Remove a prefatory “El hecho es que” frame and an optional emphasis adverb before the main proposition, so the sentence begins with its condition.

all_of: The source has a detachable fact-framing phrase before a conditional proposition.
An emphasis adverb occurs before the proposition’s main predicate.
exclude_if: The framing phrase or adverb contributes a necessary contrast, evidential qualification, or degree of certainty.

preserve: The negative-income condition.

records.abstract_quote: El hecho es que, si su ingreso neto mensual es negativo, realmente
records.adaptation_quote: Si su ingreso neto mensual es negativo

skills.name: Redundant synonymous relationship terms reduced
skills.action: When two adjacent terms describe the same relationship, retain one rather than repeating it with a near-synonym.

all_of: The source coordinates two terms that express the same relationship between the same entities.
exclude_if: The coordinated terms denote distinct relationships or add separate qualifications.

preserve: The close relationship asserted between the two fields.
The reciprocal sense expressed by “entre sí.”

records.abstract_quote: están estrechamente vinculadas y relacionadas entre sí
records.adaptation_quote: están estrechamente relacionadas entre sí

skills.name: Jurisdiction fronted and quantity statement recast
skills.action: Move a parenthetical jurisdiction phrase to the beginning of the sentence and state the associated quantity directly with a copular predicate.

all_of: The source inserts a jurisdiction using a phrase such as “para el caso de [place].”
The sentence states a quantity using a predicate such as “corresponde a.”
exclude_if: The jurisdiction limits only one component of a sentence and moving it to the front would broaden its scope.

preserve: The jurisdiction to which the statement applies.
The stated participation percentage.

records.abstract_quote: La participación de trabajadores, para el caso de Ecuador, corresponde al 15%.
records.adaptation_quote: En Ecuador, la participación de trabajadores es el quince por ciento.

skills.name: Percentage notation written out in words
skills.action: Spell out a percentage that the source presents with a numeral and percent sign.

all_of: The source contains a percentage written with a numeral followed by “%.”
exclude_if: The surrounding format requires standardized numeric notation, such as a financial table or calculation.

preserve: The exact percentage value and percentage unit.

records.adaptation_quote: el quince por ciento.

skills.name: Remove a repeated category explanation
skills.action: When a category label already states a classification that the following clause merely repeats, compress the repeated explanation and separate the remaining proposition into a new sentence; do not remove a distinct condition.

all_of: The source begins with a category label or states a category explicitly.
A following clause restates that same category rather than adding a distinct qualification.
exclude_if: The clause after the category label supplies additional, nonredundant account terms or conditions.

preserve: The individual-account classification, which remains in the label.
The statement about who knows the account movements.

records.abstract_quote: Individual: tiene únicamente un titular, es una cuenta individual por lo que solamente el titular conocerá
records.adaptation_quote: Individual: tiene únicamente un titular. Solo el titular conocerá

skills.name: Recast a locative centrality construction
skills.action: Recast a construction that locates a concept within another phrase as one that presents the concept as the center of that phrase, while retaining the same concept and relationship.

all_of: The source uses ubicar with a locative phrase containing a concept and a following noun naming its central idea or core.
exclude_if: The source's locative relation is literal rather than a way of expressing conceptual centrality.

preserve: The need and capacity for association as the concept identified as central to the formulation.

records.abstract_quote: ubica en la necesidad y capacidad de asociación el meollo de la formulación igualitaria
records.adaptation_quote: ubica la necesidad y capacidad de asociación como el centro de la formulación igualitaria

skills.name: Integrate a repeated topic label into the sentence
skills.action: Convert a bare topic heading followed by a sentence that repeats the topic into a grammatical sentence using the topic as its subject, without changing the listed items.

all_of: The source starts with a bare topic label immediately followed by prose that restates the same topic.
exclude_if: The label is intended to remain a separate heading, or the following prose adds a distinct topic rather than restating it.

preserve: The identification of the listed goods as imports.
All items in the list.

records.abstract_quote: Importaciones los principales productos importados son
records.adaptation_quote: Las principales importaciones son

skills.name: Compress repeated payment wording
skills.action: In a definition that repeats the payment idea, compress the wording by removing redundant modifiers such as a second reference to payment and an explanation that cash is a means of payment.

all_of: The source defines a kind of payment or payment transaction.
The definition repeats the payment idea or describes the cash exclusion with a redundant phrase.
exclude_if: Removing the wording would erase a distinct payment condition or medium.

preserve: That the payments are made electronically.
That cash is not used.

records.abstract_quote: realizar pagos monetarios sin el empleo de efectivo como medio de pago.
records.adaptation_quote: hacer pagos sin usar efectivo.

skills.name: Use a direct definition frame
skills.action: Replace the impersonal Spanish definition frame “Por X se entiende” with a direct definition of the form “X es…”.

all_of: The source introduces a definition with “Por [term] se entiende”.
The following phrase states what the defined term is.
exclude_if: The source uses the frame to express an interpretation or qualification rather than a definition.

preserve: The defined term and the substance of its definition.

records.abstract_quote: Por producción se entiende la cantidad de bienes y servicios
records.adaptation_quote: Producción es la cantidad de bienes y servicios

skills.name: Turn process-stage nominalizations into sequenced clauses
skills.action: Recast parallel noun-phrase descriptions of ordered process steps as separate Spanish clauses marked by their sequence and expressed with finite verbs.

all_of: The source presents multiple process stages as a series of parallel noun phrases.
The stages have an order that can be stated without changing their sequence.
exclude_if: The source does not establish an order among the listed items.
Turning a step into a clause would require adding an actor or action not stated in the source.

preserve: The activity and subject matter of each stage.
The source's stage order and the impersonal construction where no actor is stated.

records.abstract_quote: una etapa de investigación de experiencias sobre el tema en otros países
records.adaptation_quote: En la primera, se investigaron experiencias sobre el tema en otros países.

skills.name: Condense relative descriptions of generated and available items
skills.action: Where a relative clause describes items as generated and available, consider replacing the finite clause with a participle and an adjective.

all_of: A noun phrase is followed by a relative clause describing generation and availability.
The source identifies the relevant country or other context for those descriptions.
exclude_if: The participle or adjective would obscure who generates the items or where they are available.

preserve: That the items are generated and available.
The country or context associated with those descriptions.

records.abstract_quote: bienes y servicios que genera y de que dispone un país
records.adaptation_quote: bienes y servicios generados y disponibles en un país

skills.name: Separate contrastive definitions into sentences
skills.action: In a clearly contrastive pair of definitions joined by “en tanto que”, a sentence break can introduce the second defined term as a new sentence.

all_of: The source uses “en tanto que” to contrast two definitions or descriptions.
Both clauses can stand as complete sentences after the break.
exclude_if: “En tanto que” expresses a temporal or conditional relation rather than contrast.

preserve: The contrast between the two defined concepts.
The substantive definition in each clause.

records.abstract_quote: un país, en tanto que la productividad, en palabras simples, es el fenómeno productivo y económico que consiste en producir más y mejor
records.adaptation_quote: un país. La productividad consiste en producir más y mejor

skills.name: Remove a redundant definition wrapper
skills.action: Remove a tautological explanatory wrapper of the form “es el fenómeno … que consiste en” when the following “consiste en” clause already states the definition.

all_of: The source defines a concept using “es el fenómeno” followed by a clause stating what it consists of.
The following clause itself gives the substantive description.
exclude_if: The wrapper adds a distinct classification or qualification that is not repeated in the following clause.

preserve: The activity or defining description introduced by “consiste en”.

records.abstract_quote: es el fenómeno productivo y económico que consiste en producir más y mejor
records.adaptation_quote: consiste en producir más y mejor

skills.name: Make supplemental report contents an explicit inclusion
skills.action: Recast supplemental items attached with “además de” as a separate sentence with a finite verb such as “incluye” when the source is listing what a report contains.

all_of: The source describes a report or record and attaches additional contents with “además de”.
The supplemental contents can be stated as contents of that same report or record.
exclude_if: The added phrase describes something outside the report's contents or changes the scope of the list.

preserve: That the listed public records and other data are included in the report.
The additive relationship and the scope of the listed contents.

records.abstract_quote: además de otros datos relacionados con el cliente.
records.adaptation_quote: Además, incluye cualquier registro público, como bancarrota o gravamen por impuestos, y otros datos relacionados al cliente.

skills.name: Fronted attribution
skills.action: Move an attribution embedded after a claim into an opening “Según [source]” phrase, then state the claim.

all_of: The source states a claim and attributes it in a following phrase such as “como lo mencionan”.
exclude_if: The attribution is already sentence-initial or the source does not identify an attribution source.

preserve: Keep the cited authors and the claim attributed to them.

records.abstract_quote: Existen varias modalidades de cheques, como lo mencionan los mismos Alonso, Brailovsky y Ortiz (1999).
records.adaptation_quote: Según Alonso, Brailovsky y Ortiz (mil novecientos noventa y nueve) hay varias modalidades de cheques.

skills.name: Semicolon replaced by sentence boundary
skills.action: Replace a semicolon between related independent statements with a sentence boundary.

all_of: The source links two complete statements with a semicolon.
exclude_if: The clauses depend syntactically on each other or the semicolon marks a condition or exception that should remain explicit.

preserve: Keep both statements and their original sequence.

records.abstract_quote: administrarnos; tomar una mayor conciencia
records.adaptation_quote: nuestra economía. Entender los factores

skills.name: Numerals spelled out in prose
skills.action: Spell out numerals used for dates and percentage rates in running prose.

all_of: The source presents a date or numerical percentage using digits in running prose.
exclude_if: The value appears in a table, formula, or other format where digit notation is required for readability or calculation.

preserve: Keep the same date, percentage value, decimal precision, and percent unit.

records.abstract_quote: El 31 de enero pasado, la tasa neta para un depósito a un año plazo que ofrecía el Banco era de 7,70%.
records.adaptation_quote: El treinta y uno de enero pasado, la tasa neta para un depósito a un año ofrecido por el Banco era de siete coma setenta por ciento.

skills.name: Active relative clause to participial modifier
skills.action: Replace an active relative clause describing who offered an item with a participial modifier that makes the item the offered object and names the offerer with “por.”

skills.name: Select and preserve comparable interim results
skills.action: When a source reports interim-period order and sales results on both overall and organic bases, alongside adjusted earnings and broader financial detail, select representative claims for those measures. Retain the selected claims as complete source sentences without implying that they are the only relevant results.

all_of: The source reports an interim-period order result with overall and organic comparisons.
The source reports an interim-period sales result with overall and organic comparisons.
The source reports adjusted net income and earnings per share, alongside broader financial or operating detail.
exclude_if: The source does not report these interim-period results on the stated overall and organic bases.

preserve: For selected order and sales results, keep the stated reporting period, reported amount and unit, and overall-versus-organic comparison basis and direction.
For selected adjusted earnings, keep adjusted net income tied to its stated period and amount, and preserve the stated per-share amount and comparison basis.

records.abstract_quote: Q4 orders of $679 million were up 10% overall and up 7% organically.

skills.name: Select outlook across distinct horizons
skills.action: When a source provides separate near-term and full-year financial outlook claims, select claims that retain each stated horizon and its forecast ranges or comparisons. Keep forecasts identifiable as forecasts and do not treat repeated claims as evidence that other guidance was unchanged.

all_of: The source provides separate outlook claims for a shorter reporting horizon and a full-year horizon.
The source states forecast ranges or growth comparisons for those horizons alongside other forecast details.
exclude_if: The source does not provide outlook claims for both a shorter horizon and the full year.

preserve: Keep each selected forecast tied to its stated reporting horizon and distinguish it from reported results.
Retain selected forecast ranges and their stated comparison baselines and growth basis.
Keep shorter-horizon metrics distinct from full-year guidance when both are selected.

records.abstract_quote: So in summary, we are projecting organic revenue growth of 6% to 8% for the year, and earnings per share expectations are in the range of $5.65 to $5.95, a 9% to 15% increase over 2020.

skills.name: Select adjusted and GAAP per-share results together
skills.action: When a source states adjusted per-share earnings and a GAAP per-share net loss for the same reporting period, select both results and retain their distinct bases and any stated adjustment to the adjusted result.

all_of: The source reports adjusted per-share earnings and a GAAP per-share net loss for the same reporting period.
The source states an adjustment associated with the adjusted earnings.

preserve: The stated reporting period and per-share unit for each result.
The distinction between adjusted earnings and the GAAP net loss.
The explicitly stated adjustment amount, per-share unit, one-time and noncash qualifications, and related business scope.

all_of: The source gives an explicit full-year capital spending forecast with a numeric range.

preserve: The stated forecast horizon, reported amount and currency, and numeric range.
The stated comparison baseline and reduction qualification.
The stated spending composition and its qualification.

skills.name: Retain earnings and book-value bases and comparisons
skills.action: When selecting earnings-per-share and book-value claims, retain the stated accounting basis, per-share basis, measure type, reporting period, amounts, and any changes linked to their stated comparison baseline.

preserve: The earnings measure remains identified by its stated accounting basis, per-share basis, and reporting period.

skills.name: Retain EPS result qualifiers
skills.action: When selecting an EPS result, retain its stated share basis, amount and unit, change, and explicit calculation qualifiers; do not assign an accounting label that the source does not provide.

The source explicitly qualifies the EPS calculation.

preserve: The measure is diluted earnings per share.
The stated change and reported amount remain tied to that measure.
The explicitly stated exclusions remain attached to the result.

skills.name: Select forecast ranges without blending horizons
skills.action: When selecting revenue and diluted EPS claims from an outlook passage, retain each stated range and horizon, keeping forecasts distinct from reported results and not transferring a horizon from one forecast to another.

all_of: The source presents revenue and diluted EPS as forecasts with stated ranges.
The outlook passage includes other forecast metrics.

preserve: The revenue range remains attached to revenue, and no horizon is added where the source does not state one.
The diluted EPS range retains its explicitly stated horizon.
Both claims remain forecasts rather than reported results.

skills.name: Select a record unit-development result
skills.action: When selecting a full-period unit-development result, retain the stated gross-opening and net-new-unit figures together with any explicitly stated record characterization and contribution relationship.

all_of: The source reports both gross openings and net new units for a stated period.
The source explicitly characterizes the unit-development result as a record.
The source includes other operational or financial details beyond this result.
exclude_if: The source does not distinguish gross openings from net new units.

preserve: The stated reporting period and the reported gross-opening and net-new-unit amounts and units.
The stated relationship between the gross openings and net new units, including any contribution qualification.
The source's historical or industry-record characterization.

skills.action: When selecting an overall sales-growth result that reports system sales, same-store sales, and unit growth, keep the stated reporting period and all three measures together, with any separate comparison baseline attached to the measure it qualifies.

all_of: The source reports system-sales growth alongside same-store-sales growth and unit growth.

exclude_if: The source does not distinguish the comparison baseline from the stated-period growth measure.

preserve: The stated reporting period and the system-sales and unit-growth measures.

The stated scope of the result, without inferring a company or segment scope not given in the claim.
